hero.title: Eye Detection
hero.subtitle: A cascade file, a camera, a box.
hero.tagline: A short OpenCV notebook that opens the webcam, loads haarcascade_eye.xml, and draws a rectangle around each eye it finds.
hero.impact: The same loop works for a different target: swap the XML for another Haar cascade and the detector follows.

problems.d: A still photo is easy to inspect. The notebook has to find eyes in every frame coming off the webcam.
Haar cascades ship as XML. The detector loads a trained file instead of fitting weights in the notebook.
Hand, fist, and face use the same detect-and-draw loop. Only the cascade file changes.
The capture loop has to release the camera. Escape ends the window and calls release.

layers.title: Webcam
layers.desc: cv2.VideoCapture(0) reads frames until the loop breaks

layers.title: Haar XML
layers.desc: CascadeClassifier loads haarcascade_eye.xml. The repo also stores that file next to the notebook

layers.title: detectMultiScale
layers.desc: Each frame is converted to gray, then scanned with scale 1.1 and minNeighbors 10

layers.title: Overlay
layers.desc: A white rectangle marks each box. Escape (key 27) stops the loop and closes the window

highlights: Live eye boxes from the default webcam
White rectangle drawn on each hit
Escape releases the camera and destroys the window
Swap the XML to point the same loop at another cascade
